Add 75 public theorem proofs in 16 new modules. Construct exact native
reserve traces, forced four-label primaries, weighted protected palettes,
and the complete external matching family for two exceptional pairs with
an optional fifth exceptional star. Preserve whole selected boundaries,
actual copy identities, old-core parity and true core-deficit load bounds.

Keep the safe residual, retained cores and quantitative budgets explicit.
Preserve all prior mathematical sources and proof records, retain the 51/69
numbered inventory, and leave the main theorem unverified. Include genuine
development failures, independent reviews, frozen full verification evidence
and the concrete next safe-residual construction target.","parents":[{"sha":"f2510d10c114bcf3d0003b5e2e4e35cb0400167d","url":"https://api.github.com/repos/fly31415926/overfull-lean/git/commits/f2510d10c114bcf3d0003b5e2e4e35cb0400167d","html_url":"https://github.com/fly31415926/overfull-lean/commit/f2510d10c114bcf3d0003b5e2e4e35cb0400167d"}],"verification":{"verified":false,"reason":"unsigned","signature":null,"payload":null,"verified_at":null}}
